How it works

Working Principle of Collar Fitting Machine

  • 1. Container Feeding Containers are automatically fed into collar fitting section through synchronized conveyor systems.
  • 2. Collar Feeding Process Machine automatically feeds collars or neck rings through vibratory bowl feeders or automatic placement systems.

➜ Servo synchronization ensures accurate collar positioning and smooth container handling.

  • 3. Collar Fitting Operation Machine handles: ✔ Perfume bottle collars ✔ Spray bottle collars ✔ Decorative neck rings ✔ Cap support collars ✔ Cosmetic bottle accessories ✔ Industrial container collars

accurately and continuously.

  • 4. Precision Pressing & Placement Process Machine performs: Collar alignment Pressure controlled fitting Neck ring pressing Secure collar locking Smooth finishing operations

for premium packaging appearance and accurate assembly quality.

  • 5. Inspection & Automation Integration Optional systems include: Vision inspection systems Collar presence detection Reject systems Batch coding integration Automation synchronization systems
  • 6. Finished Container Discharge Collar fitted containers discharged automatically for: Capping operations Crimping Labeling Cartoning Retail packaging
